title: Metal found near the Serpent Mound, area of activity

tellings.quote: because where this metal was found was near the Indian serpent mound,

plain: A piece of strange metal was found near the Serpent Mound, an ancient snake-shaped earthwork in Ohio built by Native Americans, an area where unusual things are said to happen. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, tells this on the show, citing a man named Timothy Taylor. Bledsoe points to the location as part of what makes the metal significant.
